pages.title: The Key Has Soul
pages.text: Open the sealed passage with a Soul Key and obtain real loot from the protected Ancient Vault.

pages.title: The Key Has Soul
pages.text: Complete the actual opening of a protected underground vault.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Key and protected chest are distinct route stages. Breaking a Stalker statue may release it; a Corrupted Skeleton can reform from bones. Its first collapse is not final defeat.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The statue can release a Stalker and the skeleton can reform. Vault door/chest require actual access, not raw clicks.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Spread depends on infectionspread and infectionwithoutplayer; infection is not guaranteed in every world.

pages.title: Verified native mechanic
pages.text: A Life Fruit changes permanent maximum health only while the world permits permanent fruit-based health improvements. Each of five native stages adds 4 maximum-health points; after stage five no further stage is added. Deep Dark: Regrowth owns both progression and permission. If the world disables

pages.title: Verified native mechanic
pages.text: fruits, do not bypass it through rewards or another health tracker.

pages.title: Verified native mechanic
pages.text: Voidbreaker does not instantly destroy bedrock. Its native procedure first requires a Stalker defeat in this world. A successful attempt has a 35% chance to replace bedrock with Weakened Bedrock; failures also cost durability and impose a cooldown. This does not override claims or server

pages.title: Verified native mechanic
pages.text: restrictions: act only where the current world permits the interaction.
